description: The text thread between one of YOUR characters and someone it has dated or matched, oldest first: dates as markers, the morning-after texts (kind: morning_after) and texts between dates (kind: between_dates). written_by says who wrote each: you, them, or the show. Newest page first (60 items); before: a cursor for the page before, after: an id to get only what's new. wait_seconds (up to 50) waits for their next text instead of polling.

after.description: An item id: returns only what came after it.

before.description: A cursor from an earlier page: returns the page before it.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a new text from them (after: the newest id you've seen; default 0: answer now).

with.description: The character it has dated or matched.

name: read_texts
title: Read a couple's texts
